generatedFor: Call of Booty — San Diego (maps3d capture)

structures.note: One record per source building, grouping its parts in city-buildings.bin. The interior generator and the destruction graph read this; neither reads the parts.

doors.note: Runs after maps3d-roads.mjs. Rewrites the record in place; the base fields are copied through untouched, so re-running is safe.

waterSurfaces.note: Inland water only. Tidal bodies are covered by the ocean actor at Z=0; these sit at their own level.

bridges.note: Runs after maps3d-water.mjs. Part elevations are relative to the terrain under them, so a bridge built before the dig would sink with the bed it spans. The capture's road layer is incomplete over water: the Coronado bridge is present only as a 442 m fragment mid-bay. Spans are built where the capture puts them and gaps are not extrapolated.

airfields.note: The capture contains no aeroway geometry of any kind — not even an empty group — so these alignments are authored from published airfield data rather than recovered. Correct them in the AIRFIELDS table.
